items.title: OpenAI fixes GPT-6.2 billing error that discounted Astra and Sol usage on ChatGPT and Codex
facts: OpenAI made a billing mistake at launch of GPT-6.2 that incorrectly discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage for most users.
After the fix, the same work will use more of the plan’s usage allowance; users will reach limits 40% faster on GPT-6.2 Astra and 25% faster on Sol compared to last week.
Other models were not affected, past usage will not be charged for the difference, and one banked reset is being added for Go, Plus, Pro, and Business plans.

x_posts.author: @thsottiaux
x_posts.text:
We made a billing mistake at launch of GPT-6.2 that incorrectly discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage for most users. 

We’ve fixed this now, so the same work will use more of your plan’s usage allowance. Comparing to last week, you will reach your limits 40% faster on GPT-6.2 Astra and 25% faster on Sol. You should still see these go further in usage compared to 6 Astra and 6.1 Sol. Other models weren’t affected, and we won’t charge you for the difference on past usage.

As a small token to apologize for the mistake, we’ll be adding one banked reset for everyone on Go, Plus, Pro, and Business.

items.title: Google Antigravity App ships v2.34.0 to v2.35.2 with Gemini 4 Neon, MCP Apps, and conversation management
facts: v2.35.2 (November 25) lets you change the selected model while a conversation turn is running, with a tooltip clarifying when the change takes effect.
v2.35.0 keeps local conversation history unlimited by default, offers a Conversation Management API for agents, and adds Cmd+F search inside full-page HTML artifacts.
v2.34.0 brings MCP App support and Gemini 4 Neon to eligible paid consumer plans.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship beta for automated PR review, fixes, and policy-based approvals
facts: Claude Ship is available in beta on Claude Team and Enterprise plans for GitHub repositories.
It consists of Code Review (generally available), PR Steward (beta), and Claude Approvals (beta).
The /ship command is rolling out in Claude Code and the desktop app.

items.title: GitHub Copilot code review billing will default to the organization from December 30
facts: Starting December 30, 2026, Copilot code reviews by members with a paid Copilot license will be billed to the organization that owns the repository if no billing choice has been saved.
This applies to organizations and enterprises on Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise.
To keep the previous behavior, select Member before December 30.

items.title: Anthropic ships Skills over MCP public beta for Claude
facts: Skills over MCP is in public beta: MCP servers can ship their own skills next to tools so Claude loads them only when needed.
Tasks is now generally available, allowing servers to run long jobs in the background.

x_posts.author: @ClaudeDevs
x_posts.text:
MCP turns two! What started as a protocol for connecting AI apps to tools and data is evolving to standardize how agents communicate and orchestrate work.

We’re bringing more of these agentic capabilities to Claude with Skills over MCP and Tasks.

items.title: Google Antigravity CLI 1.5.18 released
facts: Antigravity CLI 1.5.18 rejects truncated or corrupt images instead of attaching them.
It applies file permission rules to file:/// paths.
